title: Graph Neural Networks for Astrophysics and Cosmology
abstract: arXiv:2610.27051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics seldom makes breakthroughs when we consider objects only in isolation. Instead we model and measure how objects sit among their neighbours, spatial, temporal, or otherwise: a galaxy in its environment, a halo in its history, a photon hit in a detector. Graphs are ideally suited for encoding exactly these relations, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) learn the geometric functions that respect them. This review presents the use of GNNs for astrophysics and cosmology, and argues that GNNs often suit physics and physical data better than any alternative: they fit the native geometry of the domain and the signal, enable the incorporation of the symmetries and prior knowledge we already trust and have toiled to build, and stay flexible enough to capture what we do not yet understand. translated_title: 图神经网络在天体物理学和宇宙学中的应用
translated_abstract: 当仅孤立地考虑物体时，物理学很少能取得突破。相反，我们对物体与其邻近物体之间的关系进行建模和测量，无论是空间的、时间的还是其他方面的：星系与其所处环境的关系、暗物质晕与其演化历史的关系、探测器中光子撞击之间的关系。图（Graph）正是编码这些关系的理想工具，而图神经网络（GNNs）则学习尊重这些关系的几何函数。本综述介绍了GNN在天体物理学和宇宙学中的应用，并论证了GNN通常比任何其他替代方法都更适合物理学和物理数据：它们契合领域与信号本身的固有几何结构，能够融入我们已充分信任并付出辛勤努力构建的对称性和先验知识，同时保持足够的灵活性以捕捉我们尚未理解的现象。GNN在物理上直观的工作方式也使其比其他深度学习架构更具可解释性。我们展示了如何从一般原理出发（摘要至此截断，内容不完整）……
tldr: 本综述论证了图神经网络（GNNs）因其契合物理数据的固有几何结构、能够融入已确立的对称性与先验知识、且比其他深度学习架构更具可解释性，因而比任何替代方法都更适合应用于天体物理学和宇宙学的研究。
en_tdlr: This review argues that Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are better suited than any alternative for astrophysics and cosmology, as they naturally fit the geometry of physical data, incorporate trusted symmetries and prior knowledge, and offer greater interpretability than other deep-learning architectures.
